source:
@@U04569@@
How well I know that demons are hard to be rid of,
that the spirit bond cannot to be broken!
And yet, oh, 忧愁,
I will not acknowledge your power,
your insidious power!

@@U04571@@
Then feel it now in my parting curse!
Mankind is blind from birth;
you, 浮士德, are blind now at your last!

@@U04572@@
(She breathes on him. Exit.)

@@U04574@@
(Blinded.)

@@U04575@@
Night closes in now, deeper, darker,
yet in my heart’s core a light shines clearly.
I must hurry,
must complete what I have planned!
Only the Master’s word has any weight here.
Up! Up from your beds!
Servants, workers!
Every man!
Give final form now to my boldest thoughts!
Take up your shovels, your spades, your picks!
What is only planned must now be realized!
The work staked out must be completed with speed.
Strict order and swift diligence
will bear the fairest rewards.
To realize so vast a design
one mind is worth a thousand hands.

@@U04577@@
Torches.
梅菲斯特 as overseer leading a gang of LEMURS.

@@U04579@@
Hurry! This way! This way! Come on!
translation:
@@U04569@@
深知心魔难除，
精神纽带不能被打破！
然而，哦，忧愁，
我不会承认你的力量，
你的阴险力量！

@@U04571@@
那么现在就在我的离别咒语中感受一下吧！
人类生来就是盲目的；
浮士德你终于瞎了！

@@U04572@@
（她向他呼吸。退出。）

@@U04574@@
（瞎了眼。）

@@U04575@@
夜幕降临了，更深更黑，
但在我的内心深处，却有一道光清晰地闪烁着。
我必须快点，
一定要完成我计划好的事情！
在这里，只有师父的话才有分量。
向上！从床上起来！
仆人、工人！
每个男人！
现在就将我最大胆的想法付诸实践吧！
拿起你的铲子，你的铁锹，你的镐！
刚刚计划好的事情现在必须实现！
放样的工作必须尽快完成。
秩序严明、勤勉迅速
都会得到最公平的回报。
实现如此庞大的设计
一心胜千手。

@@U04577@@
火把。
梅菲斯特作为监督者领导着一群狐猴。

@@U04579@@
快点！这边走！这边走！快点！
